Regarding the organization of the impact statements, much of the detailed socio-economic data should be placed in appendices. This will improve the continuity and focus of the environmental reasoning. We are pleased to have reviewed these draft statements and hope that our comments will assist you in your planning efforts. We also look forward to reviewing impact statements for the specific projects which will result from the present planning. Please send us copies of the final statements to complete the NEPA review process.
Sincerely yours,
Robert J. Blanco, P.E.
Chief
Environmental Impact Branch
cc: Mr. Larry Levine, HUD
Mr. Orville Minney, PA DER
